insert into vm_organ_device_rel_t(tenant_id,dept_id,device_code,create_by,create_time,delete_flag,device_type,industry_code,APP_VER_CODE) SELECT #{tenantId},#{orgId},di.device_code,#{creator},NOW(),di.delete_flag,4,#{industryCode},#{appVerCode} from vm_order_devices od LEFT JOIN vm_device_info_t di ON di.device_code=od.device_code WHERE od.industry_code=#{industryCode} and od.ord_status IN(0,1,2) AND od.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND di.device_code IN
#{deviceCode}

SELECT DISTINCT m.device_code as area_code, m.device_name as area_name, '10' as area_level, m.town_code as area_parent_code, m.province_id , m.city_id , m.county_id, m.town_code as townId FROM vm_order_devices ord LEFT JOIN vm_device_info_t m on m.device_code = ord.device_code LEFT JOIN vm_order_customer c on c.order_code = ord.order_code
LEFT JOIN vm_organ_device_rel_t t ON ord.device_code = t.device_code
WHERE ord.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and ord.delete_flag = '0' and m.delete_flag='0' and c.ord_status in (0,1,2)
AND t.dept_id = #{orgId} and t.device_type = 4

SELECT DISTINCT m.device_code as area_code, IFNULL(id.device_name,m.device_name) as area_name, m.town_code as area_parent_code, m.province_id , m.city_id , m.county_id, m.town_code as townId FROM vm_order_sensor_devices ord LEFT JOIN vm_iot_device_t m on m.device_code = ord.device_code LEFT JOIN vm_order_customer c on c.order_code = ord.order_code LEFT JOIN vm_tenant_iot_device_rel_t id ON id.device_code = m.device_code and ord.TENANT_ID = id.TENANT_ID
LEFT JOIN vm_organ_device_rel_t t ON ord.device_code = t.device_code
WHERE ord.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and ord.delete_flag = '0' and m.delete_flag='0' and c.ord_status in (0,1,2)
AND t.dept_id = #{orgId} and t.device_type = 8

SELECT DISTINCT m.street_code as area_parent_code, m.provice_code as provinceId , m.city_code as cityId , m.county_code as countyId, m.street_code as townId FROM vm_order_services_rel m LEFT JOIN vm_order_customer c on c.order_code = m.order_code
LEFT JOIN vm_organ_street_rel_t t ON m.tenant_id = t.tenant_id and m.provice_code = t.province_code and m.city_code = t.city_code and m.county_code = t.county_code and m.street_code = t.street_code
WHERE m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and m.delete_flag = '0' and m.delete_flag='0' and c.ord_status in (0,1,2) and m.service_code = '9'
AND t.dept_id = #{orgId}

SELECT DISTINCT DISTINCT b.province_id AS provinceCode, b.city_id AS cityCode, b.county_id AS countyCode FROM vm_order_devices a,vm_device_info_t b,vm_order_customer e WHERE a.delete_flag = '0' and b.delete_flag='0' and a.device_code=b.device_code and b.province_id is not null and b.city_id is not null and b.county_id is not null AND a.order_code = e.order_code AND a.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND e.ord_status IN ( 0, 1, 2 ) and a.tenant_id= #{tenantId}
